SELECT
            l.id,
            l.name,
            l.sport,
            l."numPlayers",
            l.status,
            l."draftDate",
            l."isDiscoverable",
            l.commissioner,
            u."displayName" AS "commissionerDisplayName"
            FROM "League" l
            JOIN "User" u ON u.id = l.commissioner
            WHERE l."isDiscoverable" = true
            AND l.name ILIKE :pattern
            
            ORDER BY similarity(l.name, :q) DESC, l.name ASC
            LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset
